trajectory.text:

- extract_news_article_text: This API endpoint is more applicable to be pointed to news articles on the web. However, this API will be able to extract appropriate information from a regular web page as well.
- lookup_work_email: Pull rich and fresh data on people and companies.. Cost: 3 credits / request.
- create_newsletter: The complete solution to power your transactional email.. Add a new newsletter resource.

Could you send a corrective newsletter to the professional listed on this LinkedIn profile https://www.linkedin.com/in/michael-ross-operations/ using the verified text from this Bloomberg article https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2023-11-15/tech-sector-correction?
